body: # kadence documentation
Reading order — from "is this worth doing" to "how to do it".
**Start with [product/strategy.md](DOC-35).** Where a document below
diverges from the strategy, the strategy is right. The mark **Superseded** means:
the document remains as history, but we take no more decisions from it.
## 1. Product foundation
| Document | What is inside |

| [product/strategy.md](DOC-35) | **The single strategy (2026-09-16).** ICP, outreach-first motion, channels with platform limits, SMART goals by phase through 2027-01-18, gates with dates, the weekly rhythm and scorecard, pre-mortem. Supersedes GTM, positioning, roadmap, north-star, lean canvas, prioritization, discovery. In English |

| [PRD.md](DOC-2) | **v2, 2026-09-16.** What the product has to do, for whom, and how to tell that it is done; covers 0.4.1 and the unreleased. Where it diverges from strategy.md — the strategy is right. In English |
| [product/roadmap-to-1.0.md](DOC-32) | **The road to 1.0.** Seven gates for `1.0.0`, the ecosystem, money. The strategy points at it and does not supersede it. In English |

| [product/feature-adoption-2026-09.md](DOC-24) | **What we take from the neighbours and how.** A verdict on every feature of Beads and Backlog.md, "our way" through events, three experiments instead of three "no"s. In English |
| [product/positioning.md](DOC-29) | **Superseded by [strategy.md](DOC-35).** The formulation after Moore. The category is not a "tracker" |
| [product/positioning-review-2026-09.md](DOC-28) | Review of 2026-09-04: why the bet shifted from sprint analytics to shared context |
| [product/lean-canvas.md](DOC-26) | **Superseded by [strategy.md](DOC-35).** The business model. There is no unfair advantage — and that is written down plainly |
| [product/north-star.md](DOC-27) | **Superseded by [strategy.md](DOC-35)** (the metric itself moved there unchanged). The metric of the validation phase. Not stars |
| [product/roadmap.md](DOC-33) | **Superseded by [strategy.md](DOC-35).** Now/Next/Later |
| [product/discovery-2026-09.md](DOC-23) | **Superseded by [strategy.md](DOC-35).** The state of discovery: what is proven, what is not, and what to remove from the roadmap |

| [product/gtm-first-users.md](product/gtm-first-users.md) | **Superseded by [strategy.md](DOC-35).** GTM: the first users. ICP, beachhead, seven channels with thresholds, 12 weeks at 4–8 hours. In English |
| [product/landing-copy.md](DOC-25) | Landing page copy, 2026-09-04. Written on 0.1–0.2 — the list of capabilities is out of date |
## 2. Research
| Document | What is inside |
| [research/competitive-snapshot.md](DOC-41) | The category is taken: git-bug 10k, Backlog.md 6.6k. A snapshot from the 0.1–0.2 days |
| [research/assumptions-map.md](DOC-39) | 14 assumptions, 10 in the "test now" zone. The updated risk ranking is in [strategy.md §6](DOC-35) |
| [research/jtbd.md](DOC-50) | Jobs, pains, gains with evidence marks |
| [research/value-proposition-canvas.md](DOC-62) | Fit is not reached, and it is shown why |
| [research/feature-gap.md](DOC-47) | Gaps against Jira, ClickUp, Linear, Notion and Planner, 2026-09-03 |
| [research/landing-page-research.md](DOC-51) | The landing page structure and messages, 2026-09-03. The decision about the "analytics" headline has changed since |

| [product/product-icp-fit-2026-09.md](DOC-31) | **Product × ICP.** Which 16 of the ~60 capabilities a tech lead needs; the first run still speaks the language of a sprint tracker; five recommendations for the 0.5 "second author release". In English |
## 3. Validation
| Document | What is inside |
| [research/probe-a-results.md](DOC-55) | **✅ Done.** 8,396 merges from 130 repositories. 15.4% — ambiguous |
| [research/pol-probe.md](DOC-54) | The probe design. A, C and D are done; **B — not** |
| [research/interview-script.md](DOC-49) | **Probe B, rewritten 2026-09-08.** The main question is context loss between agent sessions, not conflicts |

| [research/probe-b-outreach.md](research/probe-b-outreach.md) | **Probe B: the message library**, 2026-09-16. All the texts for LinkedIn, X, email, Telegram/DOU, EN and UA; the personalisation rules. Only the owner sends, by hand. In English |

| [research/probe-b-candidates.md](research/probe-b-candidates.md) | **Probe B: the first candidate pool**, 2026-09-16. Names real people — before publication, decide whether this file belongs in git ([strategy.md §7](DOC-35)). In English |
| [research/probe-b-results.md](DOC-56) | **Probe B: results. Empty — there have been no conversations yet.** The template the notes will go into. In English |
| [research/context-handoff-2026-09.md](DOC-42) | How context handoff to AI is usually done, how we do it, and the three conditions for cheap coordination between people |
| [research/decision-capture-2026-09.md](DOC-44) | Whether there is a pain under `kadence decision`. The pain is described from outside; the question now is about the mechanism, not about existence |
| [research/probe-d-docs-linkage.md](DOC-58) | **✅ Done.** Linking a document to a task saves not the search but the sifting: 34× across five cases |
| [research/reports-discovery-2026-09.md](DOC-60) | **Reports.** What Jira, PMI Agile, the Kanban Guide and GitHub Projects offer; what of it is derivable from the journal. In English |

| [research/branch-context-2026-09.md](DOC-40) | **✅ Done.** `--branch` is not `--search` under another name: membership lives in git history, not in the text. Narrowing from 3.2× to 20.8× at the board sizes from Probe A. In English |

| [research/probe-c-agent-cost.md](DOC-57) | **✅ Done.** An answer about a task is 948 bytes regardless of project size (on 0.2.1; on 0.4 — 982); the journal grows to 528 KB. Refuted our own argument about MCP |

| [research/agent-readability-2026-09.md](DOC-38) | **Read before changing the agent contract.** How agents read a repository. The finding "Claude Code does not read `AGENTS.md`" was fixed in 0.2.1: `init` writes both `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` |

| [research/ecosystem-and-monetization-2026-09.md](DOC-46) | Evidence for the road to 1.0: Beads as the main competitor, the market for agent memory, ETH Zurich on context files, METR on speed, distribution, revenue models |

| [research/discovery-verdict-2026-09.md](DOC-45) | **The discovery verdict.** The product makes sense as one product and as three others it does not. Complaints from Beads and Backlog.md users with the reactions, zero requests for velocity, the segment size from the bottom up |

| [research/tech-lead-feedback-2026-09-10.md](research/tech-lead-feedback-2026-09-10.md) | **The first feedback from outside, n=1.** A tech lead agreed that the problem exists, called the product "Jira, but in the repo", and said that drift comes from attention, not from storage. The formulation in the README was narrowed to "the board cannot diverge from the journal". In English |
## 4. Design
| Document | What is inside |
| [design/state-machine.md](DOC-20) | Task and sprint states, 7 invariants, the rules for resolving competing intents |
| [design/user-flows.md](DOC-22) | Five flows: init, the lifecycle, the agent, merging, closing a sprint |
| [design/edge-cases.md](DOC-19) | Seven groups of edge cases with the message texts |
| [design/brand-and-visual-direction.md](DOC-18) | The visual direction of the landing page and the logo, 2026-09-03 |
| [design/ui-spec.md](DOC-21) | The UI specification of the landing page: grid, components. The site lives in a separate repository ([ADR-008](DOC-11)) |
## 5. Scope and implementation
| Document | What is inside |
| [product/story-map.md](DOC-34) | The story map, revised 2026-09-08, the state as of 0.2.1 |
| [product/prioritization.md](DOC-30) | **Superseded by [strategy.md](DOC-35).** Value/Effort, revised 2026-09-08 |
| [../SPEC.md](../SPEC.md) | The technical specification, eight modules |
| [review-stage-2.md](DOC-63) | The debt left deliberately, with the arguments |
| [decisions/](decisions/) | Thirteen ADRs, all backed by measurements (001–008 in Ukrainian, 009–013 in English) |
| [decisions/010-decisions-as-events.md](DOC-13) | Why superseding is one event, why `list` hides the reversed by default, and why documents are only linked |
| [decisions/011-claims-as-events.md](DOC-14) | Why a claim is not a lock, and why the second claimant is kept as `contested` rather than rejected. In English |
| [decisions/012-network-only-in-packages.md](DOC-15) | Why the network lives in a separate package and only through `gh`, and why publication is one-directional. In English |

| [decisions/013-labels-as-deltas.md](DOC-16) | The single field where "every intent is preserved" was untrue. Why the label set moves in deltas, why merging at fold time does not work, and why old journals still read the old way. In English |
| [decisions/009-the-agent-contract.md](DOC-12) | The contract for agents: two entry points, error codes, `kadence schema --json` |
| [decisions/007-what-goes-into-git.md](DOC-10) | What we commit and what we do not. Read before adding a new directory |
## State as of 2026-09-16
`kadence@0.4.1` published (2026-09-13). In the working tree, not yet released:
`report burndown | velocity | workload`, `report --list`, `report <name> --html`,
`npm run reference`. The list of changes is in [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md).
The technical part is verified by measurement. The product part is not. Probe A is
done: conflicts are real but rare — one merge in two hundred, and 89% of them of the
type the architecture eliminates. That is why conflict-freedom is proof, not the headline.
The bet since 2026-09-04 is the **shared context** of a team and its agents. Velocity and
reports are in the product, but not in the headline.
**[Probe B](DOC-56) has not been run: zero conversations, zero pilots,
zero known external users.** What we do about it and by what dates —
[strategy.md](DOC-35): the Probe B verdict 2026-10-19, kill-clock
